digest.component_or_area: metrics adapter for GitHub Actions CI
propositions: Coverage percentage must be extracted from the pytest-cov TOTAL line in GitHub Actions run-log tail via word-boundary grep and persisted to the tracked snapshot store.

CI-health metrics (run status, duration, red-to-green recovery interval, flake/recheck rate) must be harvested from GitHub Actions run metadata and stored as labeled snapshots in .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson.
The GHA adapter must remain an isolated, optional module that is not imported by core metrics modules, preserving portability for alternate CI adapters.
The harvest script must read from the GitHub Actions API and write snapshots locally without depending on CI workflow permissions or ephemeral checkout environments.
Snapshots emitted by the harvester must carry source labels so they integrate into the going-forward metrics series without dependency on GitHub Actions log-retention window.
